evidence: The proposed predecessor link cannot detect a caller omitting the old history: the existing predecessor mechanism also accepts caller-owned unauthenticated files. staged-review-contract.md:337-339 and dual-track-review-gate.md:527-529 explicitly retain that trusted-local limitation. Default task authorization with method checkpoints and complete cumulative history is the intended changed behavior; explicit user cost/count/stop limits still govern. There is no claim that a stateless controller can authenticate total prior task spending, and a new fixed task cap would reverse the accepted contract.
